method: Rendered every page of both scanned booklets with music_pages.py render at 130 dpi (32 PNGs in /private/tmp/claude-501/music-second-reader-2012ol/listening and /composing) and read every ask page in full on the render (listening 2-6 and 8-11; composing 3-11). The pages the file lists without asks (listening 1, 7, 12-16; composing 1, 2, 12-16) were checked on contact sheets: covers, BLANK PAGE and ROUGH WORK only. Every question line was then read on PyMuPDF clips at 250-500 dpi (/private/tmp/claude-501/music-second-reader-2012ol/zoom). The clips settled: the curly apostrophes in "I’m" (twice) and "doesn’t" (p2 lyrics, 500 dpi) and the curly double quotes round “any way the wind blows” (p3); the full stops in the p2 headings "Excerpt 1." / "Excerpt 2." / "Excerpt 3." against the bare "Excerpt 1/2/3" on p3, p8-p11; "THREE" / "ONCE" / "TWICE" in capitals throughout; "Q.5 Irish Music" (no full stop) and its unbulleted "You will hear ..." text against "Q. 6 Aural Skills." (full stop); "J.S. Bach" (p5) against "J.S.Bach" (p11); "No.1" with no space (p6, twice); the en dashes in "bars 1–7" (p6, p10) and "Bars 1–16" / "bars 1–16" (p11) and the SEC comma in "(bars 1–7), will then be played"; the hyphen in "non-traditional" (p8); on the composing booklet the Section A stem (full stops after "Q3" and "sections") and the Section B stem (no full stop after "Q6"); "In the case of both (a) and (b)," (comma) and the three bullets printed once for both parts of Q1, each part's instrument list beside its label; "Answer (a) and (b)." printed once under the Q3 title; "eight-bar"; "keynote" (p3, p5) against "key note" (p4); the unbulleted poem lines of Q2; "PREPARATORY WORK" in plain capitals; the em dashes in the four cadence lines of Q4 (p7); and the printed flat in "B♭ major" (p10). As a second, mechanical proof, every string was split at its bullets, newlines and tick boxes and each line was found in the lane OCR (ocr/2012-ol-008.json, ocr/2012-ol-006.json) after normalising quotes, dashes and the flat (the OCR gives straight quotes, hyphens and "b"); no line was missing. Every string was scanned for straight quotes, double or trailing spaces and ASCII hyphens: none, bar the printed hyphens in "non-traditional" and "eight-bar". Code points used: U+2019, U+201C/U+201D, U+2013 (20, all printed en dashes), U+2014 (8, Q4 cadence lines), U+266D (2), U+2022, U+25A1, all as the renders print them. Addresses were checked against the printed numbering: Q1 numbers its parts afresh under each excerpt (Excerpt 1 (i)-(iv), Excerpt 2 (i)-(iii), Excerpt 3 (i)-(iii)); Q2, Q3 and Q4 (i)-(v); Q5 Excerpt 1-3 (i)-(iii); Q6 Excerpt 1 (i)-(iii), Excerpt 2 (i)-(iii), Excerpt 3 (i)-(v); composing Section A Q1 (a)/(b), Q2 (no (a)/(b) printed: one ask), Q3 (a)/(b); Section B Q4, Q5, Q6. All 53 addresses match the print. One entry per (ask, field), null fields skipped (excerptLine is null for Q2-Q4, one excerpt per question).
